title: A journal post's own heading writes its title raw, so a title can add a dead link or raw HTML to the post
symptom: journal add and the done and close post writers write '# <title>' unescaped; a title holding [x](y) or <b> gives the post a dead link and raw HTML
trigger: A post title, or a session objective for a done or close post, holding brackets, parentheses or angle brackets
expected: Every relative Markdown link in the vault resolves (REQ-cli-044); the index line now escapes the same title
actual: The heading is the raw title
environment: local-macos-arm64, tester build at 0ee26ac0, debug, SpecSync 6.2.0
impact: Dead links and stray HTML in posts
source: t38b, test stage, independent retest of K3 to K5

notes.text: Added despite similar reports: K5 fixed the index's link text; this is the post file's own heading, written by journal add and the done and close post writers
